SELECT gh.req_id, gh.req_date, gs.name, CASE WHEN gh.from_date IS NULL THEN v1.arrival_time ELSE gh.from_date END AS from_date, CASE WHEN gh.to_date IS NULL THEN v2.arrival_time ELSE gh.to_date END AS to_date, gh.gh_id, ct.gh_name, gh.block_id, bl.block_name, gh.purpose, pr.item_title, gh.category_type, qu.quota_desc, gh.desg, vc.desg_category, gh.mobile_no, gh.email_id, gh.status, gh.userid,gh.roomtype, v1.arrival_time AS arr_time,v2.arrival_time AS depart_tim,gh.cancelled_by,gh.nod_g_req,coalesce(gh.can_status,'') as can_status FROM gad_request AS gh LEFT JOIN quota AS qu ON gh.category_type=qu.quota_type LEFT JOIN visitor_category AS vc ON gh.desg=vc.vc_id LEFT JOIN gh_details AS ct ON ct.gh_id= gh.gh_id LEFT JOIN room_block AS bl ON bl.block_id= gh.block_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_req AS v1 ON v1.req_id=gh.req_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_req1 AS v2 ON v2.req_id=gh.req_id INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY SUBSTRING(guest_id, 3) ASC) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON gh.req_id = gs.req_id LEFT JOIN m_purpose_items AS pr ON gh.purpose=pr.item_id LEFT JOIN cancel_reservation cr on cr.req_id=gh.req_id

SELECT count(*) FROM gad_request AS gh LEFT JOIN quota AS qu ON gh.category_type=qu.quota_type LEFT JOIN visitor_category AS vc ON gh.desg=vc.vc_id LEFT JOIN gh_details AS ct ON ct.gh_id= gh.gh_id LEFT JOIN room_block AS bl ON bl.block_id= gh.block_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_req AS v1 ON v1.req_id=gh.req_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_req1 AS v2 ON v2.req_id=gh.req_id INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY SUBSTRING(guest_id, 3) ASC) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON gh.req_id = gs.req_id LEFT JOIN m_purpose_items AS pr ON gh.purpose=pr.item_id LEFT JOIN cancel_reservation cr on cr.req_id=gh.req_id

SELECT gh.req_id, gh.req_date, gh.category_type, gh.from_date, gh.to_date, gh.no_of_days, gh.gh_id, gh.block_id, gh.nor_req, gh.nod_g_req, pr.item_title, mr.mod_id, mrr.mrr_id, mrr.type, gh.status, gs.name, gs.designation, gs.department,COALESCE(gh.no_of_adults,0) as no_of_adult, tr.mod_status, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY gh.req_id) AS row_count FROM gad_request AS gh INNER JOIN mod_req AS mr ON mr.req_id = gh.req_id INNER JOIN mod_req_room AS mrr ON mrr.mod_id = mr.mod_id INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY SUBSTRING(guest_id,3)) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON gh.req_id = gs.req_id LEFT JOIN m_purpose_items AS pr ON gh.purpose=pr.item_id JOIN (SELECT mod_status, mrr_id FROM tr_allotment GROUP BY mod_status, mrr_id) AS tr ON tr.mrr_id = mrr.mrr_id

SELECT gh.req_id, gh.req_date, gh.category_type, gh.from_date, gh.to_date, gh.no_of_days, gh.gh_id, gh.block_id, gh.nor_req, gh.nod_g_req, pr.item_title, mr.mod_id, mrr.mrr_id, mrr.type, gh.status, gs.name, gs.designation, gs.department,ts.prev_order_date, COALESCE(gh.no_of_adults,0) as no_of_adult, tr.mod_status, ts.prev_order_no, ts.subject, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY gh.req_id) AS row_count FROM gad_request AS gh INNER JOIN mod_req AS mr ON mr.req_id = gh.req_id INNER JOIN mod_req_room AS mrr ON mrr.mod_id = mr.mod_id INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY SUBSTRING(guest_id,3)) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON gh.req_id = gs.req_id LEFT JOIN m_purpose_items AS pr ON gh.purpose=pr.item_id JOIN (SELECT mod_status, mrr_id FROM tr_allotment GROUP BY mod_status, mrr_id) AS tr ON tr.mrr_id = mrr.mrr_id JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT req_id, subject, prev_order_no,prev_order_date FROM tr_sms_alltment WHERE status = 'MODF') ts ON ts.req_id = gh.req_id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (rd.room_no, bed_nums.num) rd.room_no, concat('B', bed_nums.num) AS bed_no, tr.from_date, tr.to_date, tr.status, tr.room_rent, tr.mrr_id, tr.allot_id, gs.name FROM room_details AS rd CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, rd.max_no_beds::integer) AS bed_nums(num) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM tr_allotment WHERE status NOT IN ('CAN', 'COUT') AND from_date::date = ?::date AND block_id = ? AND gh_id = ? ) AS tr ON rd.room_no = tr.room_no AND concat('B', bed_nums.num) = tr.bed_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details ) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1 ) AS gs ON tr.req_id = gs.req_id WHERE rd.block_id = ? AND rd.gh_id = ? AND rd.room_type = 'D' AND rd.status = true ORDER BY rd.room_no, bed_nums.num

SELECT cr.can_id, cr.process_id, COALESCE(cr.mode_of_cancel, '') as mode_of_cancel,COALESCE(cr.remarks, '') as remarks, gh.req_id, gh.req_date, gs.name, gh.from_date, gh.to_date, gh.gh_id, ct.gh_name, gh.block_id, bl.block_name, gh.purpose, gh.status, pr.item_title, gh.category_type, qu.quota_desc, vc.desg_category, gh.mobile_no, gh.userid, gh.roomtype, pcr.from_date AS pc_from_date, pcr.to_date AS pc_to_date, nt.from_date AS c_from_date, nt.to_date AS c_to_date, (CASE WHEN (nt.req_id IS NOT null OR pcr.req_id IS NOT null) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_c FROM cancel_reservation cr JOIN gad_request gh on gh.req_id = cr.req_id JOIN quota AS qu ON gh.category_type=qu.quota_type JOIN visitor_category AS vc ON gh.desg=vc.vc_id JOIN gh_details AS ct ON ct.gh_id= gh.gh_id JOIN room_block AS bl ON bl.block_id= gh.block_id JOIN m_purpose_items AS pr ON gh.purpose=pr.item_id JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON gh.req_id = gs.req_id LEFT JOIN partial_cancel_request pcr ON pcr.req_id = gh.req_id LEFT JOIN noc_table nt ON nt.req_id = gh.req_id WHERE cr.status != 'CAN'

SELECT distinct STRING_AGG( (SELECT CONCAT(a.prev_room_no, CASE WHEN prev_bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', prev_bed_no) END )), ',') AS prev_room_no, STRING_AGG( (SELECT CONCAT(a.room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) else null END )), ',') AS room_no,gd.name,rb.block_name,ghd.gh_name,gr.from_date,gr.to_date,gr.req_id, gr.email_id,gr.mobile_no FROM (select distinct req_id,room_no,bed_no,mod_status,prev_room_no,prev_bed_no,status from tr_allotment) a join gad_request gr on a.req_id=gr.req_id join (select distinct on (req_id) name,req_id from guest_details order by req_id,guest_id asc) gd on a.req_id=gd.req_id join room_block rb on gr.block_id=rb.block_id join gh_details ghd on ghd.gh_id=gr.gh_id WHERE a.status NOT IN ('CAN') AND a.req_id =? AND a.mod_status ='MODF' GROUP BY gd.name,block_name,ghd.gh_name,gr.from_date,gr.to_date,gr.req_id
